title: Exact-equation campaign claim–evidence ledger
evidence_link_policy: Campaign links use the named branch; exact audited bytes are content-hashed in audit-results.json. The first checkpoint is provenance only and is not asserted to contain every later campaign record. Pin campaign links to the complete publication commit when available.

statuses.hypothesis: A proposed research goal or causal claim awaiting a discriminating test.
statuses.provisional_support: Observed support with meaningful unresolved generalization or proof requirements.
statuses.confirmed_within_scope: The precisely bounded saved-record claim was independently checked; this does not imply physical validation.
statuses.contradicted: A direct checked record falsifies the stated claim.
statuses.unresolved: Evidence does not decide the claim, or explicitly identified historical evidence was not audited.

claims.claim: The audited evaluator is the frozen source 6111d7a7, with unchanged upstream mechanics and wake sources.
claims.scope: Byte identity of the 11 available upstream files and the candidate; all checked record source identities agree.
claims.analysis_uncertainty: Content hashes establish identity, not correctness or independently timestamped preregistration.
claims.counterevidence: No mismatching source identity was found in the audited files.
claims.next_falsification_test: Recompute source and configuration hashes on every new run; reject mixed identities.

claims.claim: All 151 primary prescribed-state cases report zero inflow, force and moment difference versus legacy.
claims.scope: 7 tiny + 72 development + 72 held-out cases, 604 variant comparisons, N=16/50/100/200 in the matrix.
claims.analysis_uncertainty: The audit recomputed maxima and counts from saved records; it did not rerun the model. This is finite sample software equivalence, not physical measurement.
claims.counterevidence: An earlier support/reuse version had a positive-contribution false cull at extreme coordinates; E04 retains that failure.
claims.next_falsification_test: Adversarial accepted-domain cases against an independently implemented all-pairs oracle, especially support boundaries and coordinate extremes.

claims.claim: The corrected implementation preserves positive contributions throughout its accepted numerical domain.
claims.scope: Finite 17-entry states, quaternion norm tolerance 1e-10, coordinate components within ±1e6 m, plus tilt/near-wake restrictions.
claims.analysis_uncertainty: 85 fixtures include 78 valid cases and 7 matching physical-model domain rejections; 45 metamorphic, 33 ownership and 39 API assertions pass. Finite testing is not a universal floating-point proof.
claims.counterevidence: The v0 envelope failed at a 3e14 m translation; the correction narrows the API and adds roundoff margin rather than supporting all finite coordinates.
claims.next_falsification_test: Prove a conservative floating-point envelope or search accepted-domain boundary combinations with a high-precision oracle, retaining every first counterexample.

claims.claim: The original v0 support/reuse envelope could never discard a positive legacy contribution.
claims.scope: The claim applies to the retained pre-correction v0, not the corrected candidate.
claims.analysis_uncertainty: A direct saved two-state counterexample is sufficient to refute this universal statement.
claims.counterevidence: At a 3e14 m translation legacy/lean returned 0.001587065203100887 m/s on one rotor; v0 support/reuse returned zero. The corrected API rejects this input.
claims.next_falsification_test: Keep the exact counterexample as a permanent regression and test representable accepted-coordinate boundary neighbors.

claims.claim: Lean met the primary ≥10% field-time plus upper-bootstrap-ratio<1 screen in 8/12 held-out N=100/200 cases.
claims.scope: Two held-out seeds × N=100/200 × three prescribed-state families; nine paired repeats per case.
claims.analysis_uncertainty: The 95% paired bootstrap intervals describe these recorded timings. They do not provide a multi-case family-wise confidence guarantee or a cross-machine estimate. Raw timings include small batches and outliers.
claims.counterevidence: At N=200 only sparse passes on both seeds; dense passes neither, tilted one. Four of the twelve cases fail the specified screen.
claims.next_falsification_test: Use fresh independent seeds, longer batches and fixed balanced order, preserving previous-zero as the primary comparator; do not relabel a legacy comparison as incremental gain.

claims.claim: Four of twelve independent nonzero field cases satisfy the same ≥10% plus upper-CI<1 screen versus previous-zero.
claims.scope: Fresh seeds 628791/628792 × N=100/200 × sparse/dense/tilted; nine paired repeats.
claims.analysis_uncertainty: Four medians are ≤0.9, but only three also have bootstrap upper ratio below 1. Every saved per-case qualified flag and interval matches independent recalculation. This is a prose counting error.
claims.next_falsification_test: Generate prose counts from the Boolean conjunction of the two registered criteria and test those counts against the raw records.
claims.corrected_claim: Three of twelve independent nonzero cases pass both criteria; four meet the median-only criterion.

claims.claim: Lean has a substantial cumulative CPU field-time advantage over the allocation-heavy legacy evaluator in the observed workloads.
claims.scope: Primary held-out N=100/200 legacy/lean speedups 1.607–2.068×; all 12 fresh nonzero cases pass their independent legacy-comparator screen.
claims.analysis_uncertainty: Primary and independent instrumentation differ: checksum work is outside the primary timing and inside independent field timing. Do not pool them or generalize beyond tested CPU workloads.
claims.counterevidence: The incremental comparison against previous-zero is smaller and inconsistent across cases; this is not a new accuracy–cost frontier.
claims.next_falsification_test: Replicate on a second declared runtime/hardware environment at identical work and numerical outputs, with independent fresh fixtures.

claims.claim: A general ≥10% incremental field-time benefit over previous-zero has been established.
claims.scope: Generalization beyond the recorded fixture/count/seed combinations is not established.
claims.analysis_uncertainty: Primary screen passes 8/12; independent screen passes 3/12. No family/count passes on both fresh independent seeds. Small-sample intervals are descriptive.
claims.counterevidence: Dense N=200 primary cases fail, and most fresh incremental screens fail.
claims.next_falsification_test: Preregister a replication target and fresh seed set; repeat identical instrumentation with enough batch duration to separate workload effects from timer/scheduling noise.

claims.claim: All 14 short Boids recordings complete, and all eight matched legacy/previous-zero/lean pairs have identical saved data and stored stream hashes.
claims.scope: Two seeds; N=16 for 1 s and N=50 for 3 s; three implementations; two additional N=16 refinements.
claims.analysis_uncertainty: Full initial/final states, saved poses and held winds were compared directly; stored every-step rolling hashes agree but cannot be independently reconstructed because every intermediate full state was not retained.
claims.counterevidence: Short starting-cloud windows do not test full obstacle-course passage, long-horizon trajectory stability or physical accuracy.
claims.next_falsification_test: Extend a preregistered bounded trajectory window using the same initial states, full-state rolling hashes, stop-reason equality and untouched seeds; retain failed members.

claims.claim: Both one-second N=16 refinement comparisons pass their 1 cm saved-position screen.
claims.scope: Seed 4391 only, 21 common saved frames; physics step 2.5→1.25 ms or airflow interval 10→5 ms changed separately.
claims.analysis_uncertainty: Recomputed maximum position differences: 7.213822827802545e-9 m and 0.0070135070174269076 m. One refinement level and one short window do not estimate a convergence order or a physical error.
claims.counterevidence: Airflow-refresh sensitivity is far larger than rigid-body-step sensitivity, and historical long-horizon/cadence failures remain unresolved, not erased by this screen.
claims.next_falsification_test: Use independently declared longer common-state windows and at least three refinement levels for airflow cadence, with synchronized-time errors and stop reasons; no tuning after evaluation.

claims.claim: The exact implementation establishes converged long-horizon trajectories.
claims.scope: No such convergence study is present in the exact-equation campaign.
claims.analysis_uncertainty: Bitwise implementation agreement at a fixed cadence cannot establish convergence to a continuous-time solution. Historical evidence is marked outside this audit below.
claims.counterevidence: Only one-second cadence/refinement diagnostics were performed here. The roadmap retains failed longer trajectory and airflow-cadence screens.
claims.next_falsification_test: Resolve common-state versus inherited-state sensitivity and airflow-cadence convergence separately before claiming trajectory accuracy.

claims.claim: Measured whole-pipeline gains differ between the two workloads and both previous-zero comparisons fall below the 10% median-saving screen.
claims.scope: Primary seed 4301: seven paired N=16/1 s repeats; independent seed 628791: nine paired repeats.
claims.analysis_uncertainty: Primary lean/previous-zero = 0.9112399631, CI [0.9012365634,0.9595856530]; independent = 0.9595836221, CI [0.9357326981,1.0183059486]. Final full-state hashes match all 48 timed members; held-wind terminal hashes exist only in primary.
claims.counterevidence: Neither previous-zero comparison passes the ≥10% screen; the independent interval includes 1. Primary legacy ratio 0.846558 passes, independent legacy ratio 0.917449 does not.
claims.next_falsification_test: Use a bounded longer fixed-work workload with several untouched initial states and identical instrumentation; require identical completion/work and full-state plus held-wind hashes.

claims.claim: The exact-equation campaign provides measured N=500 or N=5,000 scalability.
claims.scope: Maximum primary prescribed-state benchmark count is 200; maximum actual Boids record count is 50.
claims.analysis_uncertainty: No measured exact-campaign record at N=500/5,000 exists in the inspected inventory. Historical unrelated missions cannot substitute for current implementation throughput.
claims.counterevidence: N=500 promotion stopped because N=200 did not show two consistently passing families.
claims.next_falsification_test: Only reopen larger-N timing after an explicitly revised or satisfied promotion gate; separate fixed-density from fixed-volume scaling.

claims.claim: The viewer demonstrates coupled browser or WebGPU simulation throughput.
claims.scope: Simulation ran offline in Node CPU; the viewer renders recorded states.
claims.analysis_uncertainty: No GPU simulation or coupled browser benchmark was performed. Static bundle checks do not measure rendering throughput or interaction correctness.
claims.counterevidence: One browser launch failed with a socket-permission denial; no screenshot or rendered interaction QA was obtained.
claims.next_falsification_test: Run a separately specified authorized browser/GPU implementation-equivalence and fixed-work throughput experiment; separate simulation and rendering times.

claims.claim: The frozen model predicts physical receiver forces and moments for this vehicle.
claims.scope: The model combines an isolated-hover source profile with a constant-ideal-induced-power receiver response, sampled at four rotors.
claims.analysis_uncertainty: No independent measured receiver-force or moment observations were acquired or compared here. Paper-derived source geometry alone cannot validate the receiver response. Source strength is fixed by isolated-hover weight while nominal receiver motor states vary.
claims.counterevidence: Code and control may agree exactly while sharing a structurally wrong source operating-condition or receiver-response assumption.
claims.next_falsification_test: Prioritize independently measured one-source/one-receiver data: hold geometry and operating conditions fixed, input measured local inflow to isolate receiver response, and test untouched inflow/load conditions with reported measurement uncertainty.

claims.claim: Linear superposition of wakes and the finite spatial cutoffs accurately represent multi-vehicle airflow.
claims.scope: Frozen source axial cutoff 2.5 m, radial cutoff three model half-widths, center search 3 m; algebraic overlap.
claims.analysis_uncertainty: Exact-zero omission is exact only relative to those imposed supports. It says nothing about omitted real tails, wake deformation, rotor-resolved flow, confinement or turbulence.
claims.counterevidence: No independently measured multi-wake reference is part of this campaign.
claims.next_falsification_test: After one-source/one-receiver validation, hold out a two-source receiver experiment with offset/overlap conditions and measured inflow/load uncertainty; compare linear addition with preregistered alternatives.

claims.claim: The research has established a new physically grounded accuracy–computation frontier toward 5,000 coupled browser drones.
claims.scope: This remains the original research target, not a conclusion of same-equation optimization.
claims.analysis_uncertainty: A frontier requires multiple approximations, independently validated prediction error and matched computational budgets. Here all selected implementations target one unvalidated equation set.
claims.counterevidence: No physical error axis, current GPU benchmark, novel-method external baseline or exact-campaign N=500/5,000 measurement is available.
claims.next_falsification_test: First establish a narrow physical prediction contract and independent held-out reference; only then compare approximation families at matched error and cost.

priority_next_experiment.question: Does the receiver force response predict independent measured force under matched inflow and operating conditions?
priority_next_experiment.why_this_first: The scientifically essential physical-error axis is missing. Additional speed measurements cannot supply it; isolating the receiver separates source-profile error from receiver-model error.
bounded_design: First establish access to numerical observations with geometry, source/receiver operating conditions, repeated-force measurements and uncertainty. A plot image or simulation-generated reference is insufficient for the primary validation claim.
Freeze the current receiver law and a unit/geometry mapping before residual inspection. Use measured receiver-plane inflow as model input when available, so the first test isolates the receiver law.

Choose a compact set of up to three inflow strata and up to three receiver operating levels supported by the data; reserve entire operating-condition groups or independent trials as held-out data, rather than random neighboring samples.

Preregister an accuracy tolerance appropriate to the intended physical prediction, measurement uncertainty, signed bias, normalized force error and uncertainty coverage. Do not choose the tolerance after seeing residuals.

Stop this bounded phase after data adequacy and one frozen held-out receiver-response evaluation. Report out-of-domain conditions and missing measurements as blockers; do not fill them with model-generated values.
priority_next_experiment.falsifier: Consistent held-out force bias or errors outside the predeclared combined measurement/model tolerance reject the receiver-response adequacy claim within those conditions.
priority_next_experiment.if_raw_data_unavailable: Do not claim physical validation. Retain a data-readiness failure, document the exact missing metadata/measurements, and separately test the known airflow-cadence sensitivity with synchronized common-state refinements. This numerical fallback cannot replace the physical test.
priority_next_experiment.after_this: Only after a credible pair baseline, test two-source overlap and compare approximation error versus CPU/GPU cost.

publication_version_note: This audit adjudicates the original exact-equation evidence. Its original-report 4/12 counting error is retained as a contradicted claim; the corrected publication documents 3/12 in research/campaign-exact-efficiency/CORRECTIONS.md. Recorded run identities and scientific conclusions are unchanged.
